# Ardent Performance Computing

> > Database performance consulting and technical writing by Jeremy Schneider, specializing in PostgreSQL and Oracle Database optimization, clustering, and disaster recovery.

Jeremy Schneider shares deep technical expertise through blog posts, conference talks, and hands-on tutorials covering PostgreSQL, Oracle RAC, CloudNativePG, and database performance engineering. The site serves as a resource for database professionals seeking practical solutions to complex performance and reliability challenges.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- Oracle Database
- CloudNativePG
- Database Performance
- Oracle RAC
- Synchronous Replication
- Disaster Recovery
- Wait Events
- Database Collation
- Jepsen Testing
- Controlfile Recovery
- OS Migration
- Development Environments
- Conference Presentations
- Hands-on Labs
